climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A small Columbia Valley AVA on the slopes of Candy Mountain in Benton County, southwest of Richland along the Columbia River, inside Yakima Valley. Wines need at least 85% local grapes.
